run_eval_runner: run an EvalRunner with a dataloader and EvalUnit to evaluate a model
create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, EvalUnit, and optional callbacks
configure_eval_runner_callbacks: configure an EvalRunner with a list of callbacks for evaluation hooks
set_max_steps_per_epoch: set the max_steps_per_epoch parameter on an EvalRunner to limit evaluation steps
review_eval_runner_save_load_state: review the EvalRunner save_state and load_state stub methods for checkpointing support
